label: D1 before an upcoming a2 choice (mid-episode); stronger after no reward
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and almost only when the agent is about to choose a2 (99.9% of activation mass; the upcoming choice is computed by the agent, so this counts as observed). It is a subset of those steps: dev precision 0.28, recall 1.0. Within D1-before-a2 it is gated by episode position. The rate peaks at trials 30-59, is low before trial 10 and after 70, and is zero at trials 90-99 (restricting to trials 10-79 gives F1 0.53). It is also gated by the model state: a moderate a2 preference (choice logit about -9 to -1.5, not the most extreme) and a mid-range value (7.1-7.7). Adding the value band gives F1 0.63 but is a readout of model internals. Magnitude is larger after an unrewarded previous trial: prev_reward == 0 covers 92% of the top activation quartile but only 17% of the bottom. Previous trials with rare transitions are over-represented. It does not fire before a1 choices, at GO or D2, or on switch-to-a2 trials (stay == 0 has almost no activations).
